resources.string: One task deadline, here and in Calendar. The total estimate, one session and daily goal are separate settings.
Estimate for the entire task, not a single session. All recorded work is subtracted. Without an estimate, no deadline pace is calculated.
The total workload is unknown. A daily pace cannot be calculated without this estimate.
Recorded %1$d of %2$d min · estimated remaining: %3$d min
The time estimate is used up, but the task is still open. Complete it or revise the remaining work: time spent does not mean completion.
The deadline has passed. Reschedule it or revise the workload; an on-time pace no longer applies.
The remaining work exceeds all time before the deadline, even without breaks. Revise the workload or deadline.
No deadline set: workload is tracked, but no daily pace is calculated.
Suggested pace: %1$d min/day. Your daily goal: %2$d min.
Your daily goal is below the calculated pace. Increase it, reduce the workload or reschedule.
This evenly spreads remaining work over calendar days, not guaranteed availability. Your daily goal and session length are not changed automatically.
